text:
:= by
  have h1 : x ^ 2 = 5 * x - 6 := by rw [h]
  have h2 : x ^ 2 - 5 * x + 6 = 0 := h
  have h3 : x ^ 2 - 5 * x + 6 = (x - 2) * (x - 3) := by ring
  rw [h3] at h2
  have h4 : (x - 2) * (x - 3) = 0 := h2
  rcases h4 with (h5 : x - 2 = 0) | (h6 : x - 3 = 0)
  constructor
  · exact eq.symm h5
  · exact eq.symm h6
